comparative_performance: Sizing change only: the P/E-history tilt is removed and every other parameter is unchanged. On the honest S&P 500 point-in-time universe, 2026-10-30 vintage, 25 bp, 20 offsets, 2,964 paired sessions, medians, the installed joint earned 13.65% a year at worst drawdown -39.24% (median -34.56%) and Sharpe 0.837 with 8.61x annual turnover; the candidate earned 13.28% at -39.42% (median -34.39%) and Sharpe 0.816 with 8.44x. The tilt's decision marginal is +0.053 bp/day, Newey-West t 0.39, month-block bootstrap -0.215..+0.323 bp/day, PSR 0.646: not significant. Removal is within every pre-registered non-inferiority tolerance: median CAGR 0.375 points lower (tolerance 0.50), median Sharpe 0.021 lower (tolerance 0.03), median drawdown 0.167 points shallower, paired HAC t -0.39 (tolerance above -2.0), bootstrap lower -0.323 bp/day (tolerance above -1.0). The other four components are kept by the same rule: the volatility target because removing it deepens median drawdown by 2.75 points against a 1.00-point tolerance; the exposure floor because removing it puts CAGR 0.415 points below the tolerance floor; the leader tilt because removing it puts CAGR 0.080 points below the tolerance floor; the 25% cap because it is a risk limit and is inert on this universe. The candidate still fails the program objective: median Sharpe 0.816 against 1.0, median CAGR 13.28% against SPY's 13.67%, worst drawdown -39.42% against the -35% bound, and 0/20 offsets above QQQ. The ablation is in-sample research on a fixed vintage, not forward proof. The 252-session forward record restarts under grade-led-leader-weight/3.
